atom_selection: heavy atoms of amino-acid residues, modified residues (e.g. MSE) included

explanation.text: Interface between chain A and chain B in experimental entry Fixture complex (synthetic, two chains): 26 residue pairs with heavy atoms within 4.5 A, computed from the deposited coordinates. No model-confidence scores apply to experimental coordinates. Model confidence is not evidence of folding, binding, affinity, efficacy, safety, or experimental validation.

limitations: Model confidence is not evidence of folding, binding, affinity, efficacy, safety, or experimental validation.
note: Contacts are geometric: residue pairs on different chains with any heavy atoms within the cutoff, in this one set of coordinates. They are not measurements of any physical property.
pae_note: mean_interchain_pae averages both directions, PAE(i in A, j in B) and PAE(j in B, i in A); it is null when the structure has no PAE.
